# VP deny precedence — D-016
The VP-configured policy excludes the `terminal` pool for `sup-crier`. A director delegation names the same pool. The delegation is retained as an auditable record, but the effective policy marks it ineffective; the call is denied. Readback names `origin: vp_configured` as the winning source and the audit row is `grant_conflict` with both source ids. No role or bridge identity overrides the VP policy.
